# fx-rates-cache

> Convert amounts between currencies with Decimal using dated rates from a pluggable source, bounded LRU caching, weekend lookback and cross rates through the base Python package `trysac-fx-rates-cache`, import name `fx_rates_cache`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
